description: Record an architecture decision in its own file, .ai/decisions/<date>-<slug>.md (id D-<date>-<slug>), so parallel branches never conflict; the AGENTS.md rules digest is updated. Use when a task settled a choice future work must respect. One line per field; refused if it contains secrets, pasted code, trees or a duplicate title.

supersedes.description: id of a decision this replaces, e.g. D-2026-10-28-bill-in-cents or a legacy D-003 (optional)

title.description: short name of the decision (max 80 chars)

name: rc_propose_adr
title: Record a decision
